mapper.update: UPDATE T_LH_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC A SET DEL_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TIME = now(), UPDATE_BY = NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MES_LH_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC B WHERE B.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND B.IS_DELETE = 1 AND B.PRODUCT_DATE = A.PRODUCT_DATE AND B.LH_MACHINE_CODE = A.LH_MACHINE_CODE)

MERGE INTO T_LH_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC A USING (SELECT * FROM T_MES_LH_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND IS_DELETE = 0) B ON (A.PRODUCT_DATE = B.PRODUCT_DATE AND A.LH_MACHINE_CODE = B.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND A.DEL_FLAG = '0') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.LH_STREAM_CODE = B.LH_STREAM_CODE, A.SAP_CODE = B.SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_RIGHT_MOLD = B.LEFT_RIGHT_MOLD, A.REMARK = B.REMARK, A.UPDATE_TIME = now() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.ID, A.PRODUCT_DATE, A.LH_MACHINE_CODE, A.LH_STREAM_CODE, A.SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_RIGHT_MOLD, A.CREATE_TIME, A.DEL_FLAG, A.REMARK) VALUES (SEQ_LH_IN_PRODUCTION_SPEC.NEXTVAL, B.PRODUCT_DATE, B.LH_MACHINE_CODE, B.LH_STREAM_CODE, B.SAP_CODE, B.LEFT_RIGHT_MOLD, now(), '0', B.REMARK)
